# Wordcell

> A local Markdown knowledge base with superpowers. Save decisions, sources,
> and plans as files you own, then find them by exact words or, with an
> optional local model, by meaning. Exact search and graph queries run on your
> machine without an account or model. Web capture, optional hosted reranking,
> and hosted agents reach other services.

When to use this site:
- Use wordcell.io to learn what Wordcell does, what stays on your machine, and
  the current install command.
- Use /developers for the coding-agent workflow: context for a repository path,
  AGENTS.md rules, Git history, and the Agent Skill.
- Use /docs for the documentation: a tutorial, how-to guides, the command
  reference, and design explanations.
- Use /blog for longer posts on why Wordcell works the way it does.

## Pages

- [Wordcell](https://wordcell.io/): Quick start, how notes, links, and search
  work, the measured context size and the SciFact reranking study, how
  Wordcell uses Oh, comparisons, publishing selected notes, what stays local,
  and the install command.
- [For developers](https://wordcell.io/developers): The coding-agent workflow:
  code-path context, scoped rules, note history, and the Agent Skill.
- [Documentation](https://wordcell.io/docs): The documentation index, grouped
  into tutorials, how-to guides, reference, and explanation, with the install
  command.
- [Get started](https://wordcell.io/docs/getting-started): The first-vault
  tutorial.
- [Overview](https://wordcell.io/docs/overview): The complete product README
  rendered as one page.
- [Use Wordcell with a coding agent](https://wordcell.io/docs/agent-workflow):
  Set up, query, maintain, and revise repository memory.
- [Reference](https://wordcell.io/docs/reference): Exact commands, formats,
  SDK imports, and optional adapters.
- [Publish](https://wordcell.io/docs/publish): Select notes and build a static
  site.
- [Comparisons](https://wordcell.io/docs/comparisons): Markdown, QMD, Basic
  Memory, Obsidian, and Wordcell from primary sources.
- [Evidence](https://wordcell.io/docs/evidence): The reproducible
  context-payload study.

## Blog

- [Wordcell blog](https://wordcell.io/blog): Posts on how Wordcell keeps
  Markdown as the record and how it works with other Hraness tools. Atom feed:
  https://wordcell.io/blog/feed.xml
- [Introducing Wordcell](https://wordcell.io/blog/introducing-wordcell): Who
  Wordcell suits, one saved rule traced to a cited search and graph answer,
  and its limits.
